string-array.name: release_notes
string-array.item: Left-handed mode, in settings, puts the pinned app wheel on the left, where your left thumb can spin it. The clock and quick actions move to the right, and the pinned apps editor and search\'s grid/list button follow.
HALauncher works sideways. Turn your phone and the home screen spreads out: the wheel on one edge, the clock and quick actions on the other, kept clear of the camera.

Search, settings, the pinned apps editor, set-up and About use the extra width when sideways: settings and the editor in two columns, and search with its category buttons beside the field and more results to a row.
Sideways, search opens with its results in view: tap the field to type, and scroll the results to put the keyboard away again.
